name: Sagara (Kumamoto, Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Sagara village emblem in white: a stylised device of four rounded lobes, like a cross.
history: Municipal flag of Sagara, a village in Kumamoto Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 21 September 1971.

features.role: Sagara village emblem — a stylised device of four rounded lobes, like a cross
